instruction: With GIMP, transform '/home/user/logo.png' to the '.ai' format for Adobe Illustrator.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not support exporting to Adobe Illustrator (.ai) format. GIMP is primarily a raster graphics editor and does not have native support for AI vector format export.
